An '''Illuminator''' is a member of the [[Guild of Illuminators]], the secretive guild that manufactures fireworks. When the [[Seanchan]] demolished the main Guild Chapterhouse, the Guild as a whole ceased to exist; it is carried on in spirit by the last remaining Illuminator to be alive, [[Aludra Nendenhald]].
